description: Urban Development Authority - Development plan for the municipal Council Limit of Kaduwela.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval of a development plan for the Kaduwela Municipal Council area under the Urban Development Authority Law. It involves the exercise of statutory powers granted by a specific Act (No. 41 of 1978 as amended by Act No. 04 of 1982) and constitutes a regulatory action. While it mentions a minister by name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed. The core content is about implementing existing legislation and making a regulatory decision, not about government personnel changes or structural reorganization, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
